annotations.text:
The xESS - the handheld beside the interior map.

TWO bands: a one-line identity bar, and the app area. Nothing is pinned below them.

FOUR apps. CREW is everyone you can reach - the ship included, carrying BEAM UP on its row - with what each last said under their name. ACT is the beat and one button per choice. SCAN reads the room. FIRE arms.

Every scrolling band is a gui_list_box, never a stack of rows.
